description: A deductively closed propositional theory \(T\) is consistent exactly when \(\bot\notin T\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.consistent_closed_iff.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (T : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory α)
  (hT : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.IsClosed T) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.TheoryConsistent T ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.falsum ∉ T
